unit.why: Four homiletic teachings attributed to R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev (blessing on good fortune and joy at circumcision, drinking water as Torah, Abraham standing in place of the angels, Haman's 'good heart' through Esther's holy feast); they are exegesis with no narrated events about Hasidic figures.
unit.boundary_note: the next division is an editor's note (א"ה) commenting on the last teaching (נו)
